scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a sentimental mother's birthday, [X] turns an April birthstone idea into a custom diamond necklace inquiry, comparing price tiers, chain metals, personalization, inherited-stone reuse, and whether the final fastening protects a valuable small stone while remaining adjustable and serviceable.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为感性的母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]会把四月生辰石的想法推进为定制钻石项链咨询，比较价格档、链条金属、个性化、旧石重制，以及最终扣件能否在保护小颗贵重宝石的同时保持可调节和可维修。
examples: using Lobster Clasp when adjustable chain length and routine servicing matter
adding Safety Clasp or Screw retention when loss risk outweighs quick removal
using Spring Ring or a general Clasp when a light chain must stay within the chosen budget

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While finishing a floral graduation outfit, [X] compares small earrings, a delicate neck piece, and minimal wrist or finger jewelry around chest ruffles, styled hair, and elevated shoes, checking what can be put on alone and will not catch, twist, or demand redressing before the ceremony.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为花卉毕业礼服完成最后搭配时，[X]会在胸前荷叶边、做好的发型和增高鞋之间比较小耳饰、细项链及简约腕饰或戒指，检查哪些首饰能独自戴好，又不会勾挂、扭转或迫使自己在典礼前重新整理服装。
examples: using Pin or Butterfly Back for a compact ear piece that stays clear of the neckline
using Clicker when tactile confirmation matters near styled hair
using No Clasp or Slip-On when the form can be worn without reaching behind the ruffled dress

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B stadium concert, [X] evaluates suggested layered chains, hoops, rings, and other small accessories against long walking, dancing, sweat, security screening, dense crowds, and an already stated fear of theft, requiring each piece to stay attached without becoming difficult to remove afterward.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 R&B 体育场演唱会评估建议中的叠戴链条、圈形耳环、戒指和其他小配饰时，[X]会结合长距离步行、跳舞、出汗、安检、密集人群以及已经表达的失窃担忧，要求首饰在活动中稳固，又不能在结束后难以取下。
examples: using Safety Clasp or Screw retention for compact valuable pieces in dense movement
using Fold Over or Clicker when a low-profile mechanism must resist repeated motion
rejecting an easy-release Clasp direction when pulling and crowd contact dominate the event

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While breaking a cycle of doomscrolling, late sleep, and automatic nail biting, [X] considers a spinner ring as a competing response available the moment a hand moves toward the mouth, then checks whether its closure-free form stays comfortable, unobtrusive, and accessible across work, reading, and television triggers.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 试图同时打断刷屏、晚睡和无意识咬指甲的连锁习惯时，[X]会把可转动戒指作为手靠近嘴边即可触发的替代动作，并检查这种无扣结构能否在工作、阅读和看电视等诱因下保持舒适、不碍事且随时可用。
examples: using No Clasp for a continuous ring form that is always ready as a competing response
using Slip-On when quick placement and removal matter but no fastening step should interrupt the habit response
not inventing ownership or claiming that the suggested ring cured the behavior

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a fixed romantic-date budget, [X] selects a pendant necklace as the surprise gift and confirms its fastening from seller information before the restaurant reveal, because the recipient cannot try it in advance and the item still has to fit the flowers, transport, timing, and remaining cash buffer.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定的浪漫约会预算内，[X]会选定一条吊坠项链作为惊喜礼物；由于收礼人无法提前试戴，[X]需要在餐厅揭晓前根据卖家信息确认扣件，并让这件首饰与鲜花、交通、时间安排和剩余预算共同成立。
examples: using Lobster Clasp when the unseen recipient may need length adjustment
using Spring Ring or a general Clasp when a light chain and familiar operation preserve the budget
using Toggle or Magnetic only when seller images and return terms make unintended opening risk clear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a nine-year-old's short-notice princess party at a play venue, [X] prepares a charm-bracelet station with stretch cord and also considers a bracelet gift, checking whether children can assemble, put on, play in, exchange, and take home the pieces without loose hardware or adult help.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为九岁孩子临时筹备游乐场地里的公主主题派对时，[X]会准备使用弹力绳的串饰手链工作台，并另行考虑手链礼物，检查孩子们能否自行组装、佩戴、玩耍、交换并带走作品，而不产生松散五金或持续需要成人帮助。
examples: using No Clasp or Slip-On for a stretch-cord bracelet children can operate themselves
using Snap or Push Button only when repeated child operation and part security have been tested
using Magnetic as a comparison when easy alignment must be balanced against active play

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After rejecting a less personal book gift, [X] chooses a custom floral pendant necklace from an online maker, inspects the product image, pairs it with a candle, and reaches checkout, leaving the maker's final fastening recommendation to be verified for everyday operation, visual restraint, and future adjustment before ordering.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 放弃不够私人的书籍礼物后，[X]会选定线上工匠制作的定制花卉吊坠项链，查看商品图片、搭配一支蜡烛并推进到下单阶段；付款前仍需确认工匠建议的最终扣件是否适合日常操作、视觉克制和未来调节。
examples: using Lobster Clasp or Spring Ring when the delicate chain needs familiar adjustable service
using Magnetic when everyday ease is documented without overwhelming the small pendant
using Toggle or a general Clasp when visible hardware is compatible with the confirmed understated design

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To get the most impact from a small accessories budget, [X] considers making beaded bracelets and stringing charms instead of buying finished pieces, then compares what can be assembled with basic tools, reopened for changes, repaired after a cord failure, and worn repeatedly without the connector costing more than the design.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了用有限配饰预算获得最大效果，[X]会考虑自制串珠手链和穿挂饰，而不是购买成品，并比较哪些结构能用基础工具组装、重新打开修改、在绳线断裂后维修，又不会让连接件比主体设计更昂贵。
examples: using No Clasp or Slip-On when stretch construction is the cheapest workable route
using Hook, Snap, or a general Clasp when charms need to be rearranged or the piece repaired
using Buckle only when the DIY piece becomes a wider cord or strap rather than a simple bead string
treating Ball Chain Connector or S-Hook as weak options until tool, scale, and skin-contact constraints are known

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a quiet everyday outfit step by step, [X] selects a pearl necklace and uploads it with the bag combination, then checks the rear hardware for visual restraint, compatibility with seasonal layers, and easy repeated handling.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 逐步搭建低调的日常造型时，[X]会主动询问项链、选定珍珠项链并上传它与包的组合图片，随后检查首饰后部五金是否足够不显眼、能适应季节叠穿，并能经受频繁操作，使这套造型真正可重复。
examples: using Lobster Clasp or Spring Ring when adjustability and familiar daily operation matter
using Toggle when visible rear hardware is acceptable as part of the outfit
using Magnetic or No Clasp when low-effort repetition is more important than a hidden mechanism

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After acquiring several crystal bracelets, [X] establishes a recurring cleansing and long-term-wear routine, repeatedly removing the pieces, placing them for treatment, inspecting cord and hardware after exposure, and returning them to wear only when each closure still aligns, holds tension, and shows no residue or damage.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 拥有数条水晶手链后，[X]会建立定期净化与长期佩戴流程，反复取下首饰、放置处理、在环境暴露后检查绳线和五金，并只在扣件仍能对齐、保持张力且没有残留或损伤时恢复佩戴。
examples: using No Clasp or Slip-On when stretch tension and cord condition are the post-care checks
using Magnetic or a general Clasp when residue, alignment, and pull strength must be retested
using Screw or Fold Over when threads, hinges, or trapped moisture need inspection before long-term wear resumes

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A designer building a client's classy minimalist jewelry shop from scratch defines a product-detail standard in which every fastening is photographed close up, named consistently, shown both open and secured, and checked against product type, scale, repair information, accessibility, and the brand's promise of quiet quality.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名设计师从零为客户搭建高雅简约的首饰商城，并制定商品细节标准：每种扣件都要近距离拍摄、统一命名、同时展示开启与锁定状态，并结合首饰类型、尺寸、维修信息、易用性和品牌对低调品质的承诺进行核对。
examples: showing clasp, hook, post, screw, magnetic, click, and connector families in open and secured states
making scale and operating direction visible instead of inferring usability from a product title
keeping rare mechanisms weak until the catalog actually carries them
